title: HighlightedText story covers all seven senses
story: As a developer, I want the HighlightedText Storybook story to include an example with all seven senses highlighted so that I can validate the color choices visually.
acceptance_criteria: The HighlightedText Storybook story contains an example where each of the seven senses (sight, sound, smell, taste, touch, organic, kinesthetic) has at least one highlighted span.
agent_retro: Annotation indices were wrong on the first attempt because I guessed them rather than computing them. Node script to verify/compute them caught all the errors immediately.
user_retro: While writing the story, I specified that it should update the existing story, but that didn't cross over to the story that was written down.
